subject: Vendor onboarding: banking details, PO and invoice submission (Northern Supplies)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: onboarding@northernsupplies.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: banking details, PO and invoice submission (Northern Supplies)

Hi Evan / Northern Supplies team,

Welcome — thanks for partnering with Redwood. To get your account active in our procurement and AP systems we need a few items so we can issue POs and remit payments. Please review and return the items below: 

Required items to kick off onboarding:
- Completed ACH or Wire form (attached stub: NSS-ACH-Form.pdf) — please indicate which method you prefer for USD payments.
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form) attached.
- Bank letter or cancelled check for account verification.
- Company registration / invoice remit name if different from legal name.

Payments / invoicing questions for you to confirm:
- Do you prefer ACH (default for US vendors) or wires? Is there a secondary routing for international wires?
- Who should receive remittance notifications? (email address)
- Do you accept PO-based invoicing or do you need a manual invoice sent to AP? If PO-based, confirm how you expect the PO number to appear on the invoice (PO in subject, PO field, invoice line).
- Standard payment terms you require (Net 30, Net 45, etc.). Redwood typically pays on Net 45 for new suppliers but we can discuss Net 30 for approved partners.

Next steps from our side: once we receive the completed forms and tax docs, procurement will create your vendor record and issue the initial PO. Finance will do account verification and add your remittance address/email to our AP system.

If helpful I can schedule a quick 20-minute call to walk through the forms.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: W9_NorthernSupplies.pdf (stub), NSS-ACH-Form.pdf (stub)
From: Evan Holt <evan@norserv.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: banking details, PO and invoice submission (Northern Supplies)

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick clarifications from our side before we return the forms: 

1) ACH vs wire: We prefer ACH for domestic USD payments. For international invoices (EUR/GBP) we typically process via wire. Do you need separate vendor records per currency or is a single record with multiple bank accounts fine?

2) Remittance: We have a centralized AP mailbox remits@northernsupplies.com for remittance notices. Do you require remits to be sent for every payment or only when remittance differs from the invoice?

3) PO handling: We can include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header and in the email subject. Is it mandatory that the PO number be present on the invoice PDF, or is an email-level PO sufficient for processing?

4) Bank verification: we can supply a bank letter and voided check. If you need the bank to complete a verification form or provide a reference, let us know.

We'll complete the ACH form and upload the W-9 tonight and return everything via DocuSign. Attaching a preliminary bank letter (BankLetter_stub.pdf).

Thanks — Evan
Evan Holt
Head of Operations
Northern Supplies LLC

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: banking details, PO and invoice submission (Northern Supplies)

Ben / team — quick finance notes to make processing smoother: 

- Preferred payment rail: ACH (USD) is our primary preference for cost and speed. For international suppliers we use wire; please flag any invoices in foreign currency so Finance can set the correct payment method.
- Remittance email: AP processes require a remittance email on file. Please ask Northern Supplies to confirm the single remits@ address and whether they expect remittance PDFs for each payment. We will set remits@northernsupplies.com in our vendor record.
- PO requirement: For automated matching and faster payment, the PO number must appear on the invoice PDF (invoice header or designated PO field). An email subject with PO is helpful but not sufficient for our AP automation. If Northern cannot include PO on the PDF, we will need a manual approval flow which delays payment.
- Terms: Standard onboarding workflow sets new vendors to Net 45. Exceptions to Net 45 require approval from my manager; we can make a one-time Net 30 exception for strategic partners.
- Verification: We will run bank verification after receiving the ACH form + bank letter. If account verification fails, we may request a one-time test payment or a cleared check.

Attached I am including PO-invoice-example.pdf as a reference for how PO # should be displayed on the invoice. Also: AP inbox for invoice submission is ap-invoices@redwood.ai — please advise Northern to send invoices there once they receive the PO.

Michael Grant
Finance Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0144

Thanks Evan — appreciate the fast turnaround. Summary and next steps below so we have everything in one place: 

Summary (actions for Northern Supplies)
- Complete and return NSS-ACH-Form.pdf (indicate primary account for USD ACH).
- Sign / return W9_NorthernSupplies.pdf.
- Confirm remittance address: remits@northernsupplies.com (we will enter this into AP).
- Confirm PO placement on invoice PDF (invoice header or PO field). If you can include PO on the PDF we can enable automated matching.
- If you bill in EUR/GBP, confirm separate bank details for wires and note preferred currency on each invoice.

Next steps from Redwood
- Once we have the above documents, procurement (Grace) will create the vendor record and issue your initial PO.
- Finance (Michael) will run bank verification and add your remittance email to our AP system.
- We will expect invoices to be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.ai with the PO number in the PDF.

I've uploaded the forms to DocuSign for signature and return: https://docusign.com/link/example-nss-onboard. If you prefer to return PDFs via email we can accept those as well. I attached our sample PO/invoice example to show the required PO placement.

If helpful, let's do a 20-minute call tomorrow at 10am PT to confirm details and avoid back-and-forth. Let me know what works.

Best,

Ben Carter
